learning_outcomes.text: Students know the basics of modeling and the concept of the Finite Element Method after completing the course.
They can independently learn to use modern Finite Element programs and perform basic design calculations with the programs for digital twins.
They are also able to interpret and critically evaluate existing Finite Element calculation results.

syllabus_topics: Fundamental equations of FEM and numerical procedure using planar bar elements
Continuum elements using simple plate elements as an example
Rules for creating good Finite Element models
Use of FEM programs in structural mechanics and creation of good FEM models
Boundary conditions and load assumptions in statics
Different model types and their associated finite elements
Interpretation and verification of calculation results
assessment_rules: The final grade is based on a 60-minute written exam (MABB341). A lab report (MABB342) must also be submitted and passed; it is ungraded and does not contribute to the final percentage.
bibliography: Instructor's script and the sources specified therein
